messages:
Jules: Quick sync: Customer Z wants a tenant-scoped A/B canary across multiple EU regions with per-tenant opt-in flags. They also asked for a hard rollback window and documented fallback UX. Pilot in 3 weeks.
Ravi: High level tradeoff: hosted regional canary will need secret scoping + per-region model pinning. Dedicated is simpler but customer prefers hosted.
Olga: Ops constraints: we can reuse eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 capacity, but we need to ensure data never crosses regions for the pilot (contractual). That means region-anchored routing + no global logging copies.
Kai: Proposed rollout waves: wave0-> 0.5% tenants (24h), wave1-> 5% (48h), wave2-> 25% (72h), wave3-> 100% (5d staged). Progress only if gates pass.
Marta: Recommended gates to advance: p95 latency delta <= +120ms, error-rate delta <= +0.15%, model-quality regression <= 1.5% on agreed eval set, cost delta per 1k tokens <= +10%. Any gate fail = auto-hold + notify.
Jules: Fallback options ranked: 1) serve from warmed prefix cache (fast, but lower coverage); 2) route to v2-small quant (moderate quality hit, higher latency); 3) route to customer's dedicated endpoint (if they have one). Need to show UX delta numbers to customer.
Ravi: Quick numbers: prefix-cache median latency ~20ms, coverage depends on prompt; v2-small p95 ~ baseline + 180-300ms for long prompts; v2-quant p95 ~ +90ms. We'll include these in the runbook.
Olga: Flag shape draft (JSON):
```
{
  "flag": "tenant_region_optin_ab",
  "targets": {
    "regions": ["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"],
    "tenants": ["cust-z"]
  },
  "variants": [
    {"name": "control", "model": "v2", "weight": 50},
    {"name": "experiment", "model": "v2-quant", "weight": 50}
  ],
  "waves": [0.5,5,25,100],
  "gates": {
    "p95_latency_delta_ms": 120,
    "error_rate_delta_pct": 0.15,
    "quality_regression_pct": 1.5
  },
  "rollback": {
    "auto_hold_on": ["p95_latency_delta_ms>120", "error_rate_delta_pct>0.15"],
    "manual_kill": true
  }
}
```
Kai: Ownership: infra -> implement regional routing + secret scoping; eng-ml -> eval harness + regression checks; product -> go/no-go; support/CSE -> customer comms. Need on-call rota during first 72h of each wave.
Marta: Prioritization: Sales says strategic enterprise and budgeted pilot. If we greenlight, infra sprint estimate = 2 engineers x 2 sprints to add region pinning + flag targeting + restricted log sinks. Eng-ml needs 1 engineer for 1 sprint to produce eval set and automated checks.
Jules: Scope negotiation: customer will accept a reduced scope if we can't meet infra timeline: single-region EU canary (eu-west-1) + 24h extended observation before ramp. Offer Dedicated as alternate.
Ravi: Risk note: need legal signoff on EU-data-only logging; also check 3rd-party metrics providers for cross-border data.
Olga: Runbook checklist I'll draft: pre-checks (eval set baseline, capacity warm-up), wave playbook, gates + thresholds, escalation matrix, rollback steps + communication templates. Will attach by EOD Wed.
Marta: release-bot: scheduled-deploy: cust-z-eu-ab at 2026-06-01T07:00Z; canary-window: 48h; approvers: Jules, Ravi, Olga.
release-bot: deploy-schedule created: cust-z-eu-ab at 2026-06-01T07:00Z; approvers required: Jules,Ravi,Olga.
Jules: Next steps: Olga to draft runbook + schema, Ravi to produce infra cost estimate, Marta to coordinate with sales/legal. Reconvene Fri 9am to freeze scope. :thumbsup:
